data.name: Hello Charlotte EP2: Requiem Aeternam Deo
data.detailed_description:
Intro

Hello, new Puppeteer!

Meet Charlotte — a Puppet you will control. Meet her alien friends, maggot cat and a certain Observer.

Dive deep into horrors of junk food, TV world, religion and romance novels for middle-aged women. Keep your puppet safe at all times. Or don't.

Have fun dying!

Description

Hello Charlotte is an episodic game, where each episode can be considered a separate story,

as they differ in storytelling style, themes and illustrations, but the characters stay the same.

This story, Hello Charlotte: Requiem Aeternam Deo, is the second installment of the Hello Charlotte series.

Hello Charlotte, Episode 1: Junk Food, Gods and Teddy Bears can be downloaded for free on itch.io.

Hello Charlotte games:

  • Hello Charlotte EP1 (2015) is a story about a memory of long-gone gods and loss of individuality, where your Puppet's new friend goes missing among the static.

  • Hello Charlotte EP2 (2016) is a story lamenting the impossibility of universal happiness, and idolization of those out of our reach. As her mind unravels, ink will flow, and blood-red flowers will bloom in the desolate field.

  • Hello Charlotte: Delirium (2017) is a spin-off minigame made to test some of the RPG Maker features. It's a red herring.

  • Hello Charlotte EP3 (2018) is the final story in the series, serving as a prologue and an epilogue to the main plot. A prosumer noise machine, a virulent insect, an obscene revelation — and an earnest thank you.

reviews.review:
Im starting this review by mentioning that the whole series is very abstract and has a lot of flaws so it might not be for everyone . Ep 2 is in my opinion the best part as I feel the author had the clearest vision from beginning to end , from how the characters personalities and purpose was conveyed to the hidden small symbolism sprinkled all throughout , the whole package had a really good flow all around . When you try to take the game apart you might think that there really isnt anything that unique about it , a weird cast of characters wacky for the sake of it , a likeable childish character that goes on goofy adventures etc. But for some reason ,for some sort of miracle or geniusity by the author , the game manages to weaponize these tropes in ways that make the later reveals hit harder . I have to also add that compared to a lot of fiction, the messages and themes in this game are felt properly just because of how much soul and passion was put into this project even tho the execution might not be the best in some parts. Its seems so personal in fact that even not knowing the creator you can still form an image of their personality and views on things from the period they were making the game just by playing it : an world growing more uncaring by the day , being forced to abide by the norms forced upon you by the world , a desperate attempt to escape into a fantasy where everything makes sense or has a valid reason to be . The main character struggles with these issues and as the story continues and more and more layers are peeled as you see the games reality show its ugly fangs. It behaves like it is incompetent and stereotypic at first , like it cannot convey anything of value just to lure you into a false sense of confidence and then it starts hitting every right point ,conveying every concept with such confidence its hard to not take it seriously from then on . And then you finally finish the game and you start thinking about it in the shower: "what was intentional?" , "was it all even real?" , "if so what was real and what wasnt?" and so on. I love that it expresses its points well while not answering enough(ignoring the third part) so that you think about it and it remains with you afterwards , I love when games do that part well :) .
I also love the art and the weird place this game has , being in the middle of part 1 which explains nothing and is too abstract and part 3 which explains too much and leaves almost nothing up to interpretation . It kinda makes me wonder if it reaches this sweet spot because it was made in a point of artistic change for the author seeing how much part 3 differs in its approach. 
Regardless of what is , why it is , if it all might land for you as it did for me or not , you should at least give it a try and see how it goes . It might be a memorable experience .
